usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/nlp/sentiment?text=<URL-encoded text> (text passed as query param, NOT a JSON body)

inputExample.text: This product is amazing and I love it

usage.outputShape: body.score (raw int), body.normalized (length-normalized float), body.label ("positive"|"neutral"|"negative"), body.word_count, body.positive_words[], body.negative_words[], body.positive_hits, body.negative_hits
quirks: Input is a URL query parameter ?text=..., NOT a JSON request body — it is a GET.
URL-encode the text (spaces -> %20). The expected param name 'text' is only documented in the 402 response description, not in inputSchema.
Deterministic lexicon (AFINN) scorer — no upstream LLM, same input always yields same output.
Response includes a marketing _hint field that can be ignored.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/nlp/sentiment with the text to analyze in a URL-encoded ?text= query parameter (there is no JSON body). The endpoint is x402-paid (~$0.005 USDC on Base, scheme exact) and responds synchronously with 200. Read body.label for the positive/neutral/negative verdict, body.score for the raw AFINN total, and body.normalized for the length-adjusted score; body.positive_words[] and body.negative_words[] list the matched terms. Results are deterministic.
